newsitem.title: USA: Astra USA ex-CEO makes first court appearance.
newsitem.headline: Astra USA ex-CEO makes first court appearance.

text.p: The former chief executive officer of Astra U.S.A. made his first appearance in a Massachusetts federal court on Wednesday.

Lars Bildman, fired from his job at the U.S. unit of Swedish pharmaceutical firm Astra AB, was told by U.S. Magistrate Charles Swartwood he was facing charges of conspiracy, mail fraud, wire fraud, filing false tax returns and violating interstate travel in the furtherance of prostitution.
Swartwood ordered that Bildman be detained without bail.

Prosecutor Mark Pearlstein told reporters last Thursday that Bildman used the money to pay for family vacations in the British Virgin Islands, renovate his three homes and charter yachts where he entertained prostitutes.

If found guilty, Bildman faces up to five years in prison and $250,000 fine for each count of conspiracy, mail fraud, wire fraud and interstate travel. He faces up to three years and $250,000 fine for each count of the tax charges.
